name: @oge-ui/react-charts
description: React charts from the OGE UI suite on a dependency-free SVG kernel: sixteen cartesian series types (line, spline, step, area, stacked, bar, range, scatter, bubble, candlestick), pie and doughnut, radar/polar charts and a range selector — calendar-true time axes, log axes, multiple value axes, strip lines, annotations, wheel/drag zoom and pan, crosshair, shared tooltips, an interactive legend, selection, keyboard point inspection, a screen-reader data table and PNG/SVG export — running the same framework-free charts engine and the same stylesheet as the Angular charts package. Source-available commercial license (free for evaluation and development).
author: kaya2m
